raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.window_name, c.denominator_kind, c.cost_ratio FROM v_cost_ratio c JOIN v_dim d ON c.run_id = d.run_id WHERE c.is_current AND d.is_current AND d.source_path LIKE '%u672%steady24h%' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' ORDER BY c.run_id
raw.observed: g6 u672 fc_L30_cap28__g100 on steady24h has cost_ratio=0.2349 (76.5% savings vs static_C8); fcAware cost_ratio=0.4969 (50.3% savings). All u672 forecast policies beat the static-deployment cost bound (cost_ratio < 1) on the 24h window. On burst3/4/5 windows same policies have cost_ratio 2.29-4.0 (miss bound).
raw.claimed: on the sustained 24-hour window 672^2 misses the bound on both fabrics
raw.evidence: v_cost_ratio shows u672 fc_L30_cap28 cost_ratio on steady24h is 0.235 (<1) — it beats the static bound, contradicting 'misses'. The burst-window observation (cost_ratio 2.29-4.0, misses) is accurate but the 24h claim is wrong under the cost-ratio metric the view is built to express.
